name: San Giorgio Enriched Egg Ribbon Noodles (Buttered)
whyItWorks: Egg-enriched wheat ribbon noodles soften into a tender, melt-in-your-mouth texture. Highly digestible source of gentle calories and complex carbs during low-residue recovery.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil broad egg noodles in salted water for 8 minutes until tender. Toss with 1 tsp butter or ghee and sea salt.
